verdict.rationale: The release notes confirm a first-party managed service, OCI Generative AI, that can host open models: you can import zai-org/GLM-5.3 into it in a named region. OCI services are generally exposed through documented REST APIs and SDKs, but the pack never documents a Generative AI inference API specifically. Missing for 10: evidence of frontier (proprietary) model availability, a documented inference API or endpoint specific to Generative AI, breadth of the model catalog and regions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
